_gateCommit: "warn" (default): git commit goes through, with a warning, while integrity fails · "block": the commit is blocked until integrity is clean · false: the gate is off

evict._why: The root index grows one session line per wrap and nothing removes them. Left to human discipline it reached 97.8 KB against a 16 KB limit; pruning was planned nine times and deferred nine times. This makes the eviction mechanical.
